skills.name: afk
skills.description: Sets the away posture: escalation rules while Ben is away and the return contract.

skills.name: bearings
skills.description: Produces a four-section status digest (workboard, fleet, decisions, health); file variant writes a dated report.

skills.name: decisions
skills.description: Surfaces open captain decisions one at a time, in impact order.

skills.name: dispatch
skills.description: Dispatches workboard items to crewmates or subagents: readiness gate, claim protocol, worker launch, review-feedback loop.

skills.name: herdr
skills.description: Operates the herdr CLI over the local socket: workspaces, panes, agent lifecycle states, worktrees. Use from inside a herdr pane (HERDR_ENV=1).

skills.name: laptop-watch
skills.description: Interprets laptop health and maintenance monitor output; recommends, never acts; reports under six lines.

skills.name: stow
skills.description: Persists durable knowledge into plans/ and research/ files and curates session checkpoints.

skills.name: supervise
skills.description: Handles heartbeat ticks and worker liveness: handback verification, stalled/crash/orphan recovery, boot recovery, merge-gate judgement.
